propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall type hierarchy

fetch_snapshot's three enrichment re-raise clauses (parent, comment, issuelink) match only BackendPaginationStallError and miss Cloud's error, falling through to broad except Exception handlers that log warnings and degrade
A stalled Cloud cursor produces a silently degraded snapshot instead of propagating the stall error and aborting the pass
The fix is a one-line change to declare RunawayPaginationError as a subclass of BackendPaginationStallError, enabling the existing re-raise clauses to cover Cloud stalls
Existing except RuntimeError and except RunawayPaginationError sites remain unaffected because BackendPaginationStallError itself subclasses RuntimeError
